primaryText: Jim is at home right now.
context: A non-modal assertion in the control vignette; participants rated on a 7-point scale either whether what the speaker said is false or whether they would respond 'No, ...'.

Smith, having examined evidence consistent with Fat Tony's death, asserts the epistemic might-claim; Beth knows Fat Tony is alive; participants rated on a 7-point scale either whether what Smith said is false or whether they would respond 'No, ...'.
